<!-- REPLACE: 2–4 sentences about you -->
I’m a graduate student in Statistics at the University of Illinois Chicago with a background in urban planning, transportation, and policy research. 
Over time, my work became increasingly quantitative, which led me to pursue deeper training in statistics and data science.
My interests include applied statistics, data science, causal inference, predictive modeling, and quantitative research.
